1.0.12:
• Digital KYC form: from a client's window press "KYC forms" and hand the screen to the customer. They fill in the personal particulars form and sign on screen, the ID number is checked as they type, and a PDF of the signed form is filed with the client's documents. Staff review the details against the real ID and mark the form as verified.
• Uploaded documents: from a client's window press "View uploaded documents" to see every file as a pile of cards with a preview of the first page. Click one to read it in a full viewer inside the app (zoom, next / previous), or download it. You can search and filter by type or category, and upload new files from the same screen. Each time a file is opened or downloaded it's recorded.
• New Filing Helper: open a client and press "Prepare filing" for a GST return or AGM / Annual Return. You get a checklist of the documents needed, what's already on file (and which shelf any paper copy is on), company details you can copy with one click, and one download of all the files.
• "Mark as filed" records the date and the portal reference, and updates the client's GST schedule or last AGM date for you.
• Optional GST registration number on client details.
• Admins can edit the document checklists.
1.0.11: • Maintenance release to confirm the new in-app update flow works end to end. No changes to your data or day-to-day features.
1.0.10:
• In-app updates: you'll now be asked before an update is installed, with a short summary of what changed.
• Import clients: fixed the file selection not responding, and the import now reads the "Clients" sheet even when it isn't the first sheet in the workbook.
• Clearer error messages when an import file can't be read.
